statements.status_notes: Data Prepper 2.16.0 ships Spring Framework 5.3.39. This bypasses the CVE-2024-38820 fix; its only open-source fix is Spring 6.1.20/6.2.7, a major-version upgrade not yet adopted, and the 5.3.x backport is Enterprise Support only, absent from Maven Central. Monitoring for an adoptable fix.

Data Prepper 2.16.0 ships Spring Framework 5.3.39. The only open-source fix is Spring 6.1.14, a major-version upgrade (javax to jakarta, Java 17 baseline) not yet adopted; the 5.3.x backport is Enterprise Support only and is not on Maven Central. Monitoring for an adoptable fix.

CVE-2024-38827 is a Spring Security advisory (spring-security-core AuthorizationManager case-sensitivity). Data Prepper ships Spring Framework 5.3.39 but does not depend on Spring Security, so the vulnerable component is not present in the image.
